items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: No, I played at the Savoy with Edmond Hall.

ctx.x: Were you at the Savoy in Boston?
No, I played at the Savoy with Edmond Hall. Then I had this band I was directing... This band I was directing was down at the...it was called Mahogany Hall in Boston.
Oh, yeah. That was George Wein's place.
